about: Android string resources: resource name -> the English text, exactly as iOS writes it. build_android_strings.py takes the Spanish and Portuguese from es.json and pt.json, so both apps say the same words.

strings.font_caption_literata: Made for long reading on screens
strings.font_caption_crimson_pro: A graceful Garamond-style face for long chapters
strings.font_caption_source_serif: A calm, sturdy serif with an even rhythm
strings.font_caption_spectral: A light, refined face made for screens
strings.no_cross_references: No cross references for this verse.
strings.no_verses_found: No verses found in the %@. Try fewer words or a different spelling.
strings.no_highlights_message: In the reader, tap a verse and pick a color.
strings.no_notes_message: Write about a verse from the reader, or start a journal entry with the button below.
strings.no_bookmarks_message: Tap the bookmark in the reader to mark your place.
strings.language_footer: Versely is available in English, Spanish and Portuguese.
strings.welcome_read_message: A calm reader that works offline. Highlight, take notes and pick up where you left off.
strings.welcome_listen_message: Hear chapters read aloud and follow along, verse by verse.
strings.welcome_pray_message: Keep a prayer journal, hold on to the verses that speak to you and look back on answered prayers.
strings.onboarding_tagline: Scripture, quietly and beautifully. Everything works offline.
strings.switch_any_time: You can switch any time from the reader.
strings.start_with_john: Or start with the Gospel of John
strings.summary_kjv: The classic English Bible, cherished for its majestic, poetic language.
strings.summary_web: A modern, readable translation in everyday English.
strings.summary_asv: A precise, literal translation valued for careful study.
strings.summary_blivre: The 1819 Almeida translation, updated into Brazilian Portuguese and free to read and share.
strings.sign_in_message: Sign in to back up your highlights, notes, reading plans and prayers, and see them on all your devices. Everything also works without an account.
strings.cloud_not_set_up: Cloud sync isn't set up in this build.
strings.guest_footer: As a guest, everything stays on this device. You can sign in any time and your notes will come with you.
strings.sign_out_keep_data: Sign Out and Keep Data on This Device
strings.sign_out_remove_data: Sign Out and Remove Data from This Device
strings.sign_out_message: Your data stays safe in your account either way.
strings.delete_account_message: This permanently deletes your account and your data in the cloud. It can't be undone.
strings.delete_account_failed: Your account couldn't be deleted. Please try again.
strings.delete_account_footer: Deletes your account and everything saved with it in the cloud: highlights, notes, plans, prayers, memory verses and group posts.
strings.google_failed: Sign in with Google didn't work. Please try again.
strings.apple_failed: Sign in with Apple didn't work. Please try again.
strings.confirm_email: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
strings.reset_sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
strings.session_ended: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
strings.unexpected_response: The server sent an unexpected response.
strings.server_unreachable: Couldn't reach Versely's server. Check your connection and try again.
strings.sync_footer: Highlights, notes, bookmarks, reading plans and prayers sync automatically. Prayers are private to your account.
strings.one_day_behind: 1 earlier day to catch up on
strings.days_behind: %lld earlier days to catch up on
strings.restart_message: Your checkmarks for this plan will be cleared.
strings.plans_card_message: Read the whole Bible in a year, or a book at a time.
strings.plan_one_year_summary: Old and New Testament readings each day, about 15 minutes.
strings.plan_nt90_summary: Matthew through Revelation, about three chapters a day.
strings.plan_chronological_summary: The whole Bible in a year, with books in the order events happened.
strings.plan_gospels_summary: Matthew, Mark, Luke and John: the life of Jesus in a month.
strings.plan_psalms_summary: Five psalms a day, a month of prayer and praise.
strings.prayer_title_hint: Who or what are you praying for?
strings.pray_with_scripture: Pray with Scripture: add a verse or passage, such as Philippians 4:6–7.
strings.answer_note_footer: Optional: a few words to remember how God answered.
strings.no_prayer_requests_message: Add the people and needs you're praying for. Your journal is private to you.
strings.no_answered_prayers_message: When a prayer is answered, mark it here to remember God's faithfulness.
strings.no_matching_prayers_message: Try another word from the title or the prayer.
strings.passage_unreadable: Type a book, chapter and verse, such as John 3:16.
strings.passage_not_in_bible: That passage isn't in the Bible you're reading.
strings.passage_missing: This passage isn't in the Bible you're reading.
strings.prayer_card_message: Keep a private record of what you're praying for.
strings.prayer_streak: %lld days in a row of prayer
strings.prayed_today_fresh: You've prayed today. Every day is a fresh start.
strings.quiet_moment: Take a quiet moment with God today.
strings.answer_wait_none: When a prayer is answered, you'll see how long the answer took.
strings.answer_wait_day: Answers came within a day, on average.
strings.answer_wait_one: Answers came after about a day, on average.
strings.answer_wait_days: Answers came after about %lld days, on average.
strings.story_with_god_message: Prayers and answers appear here by month, so you can look back on God's faithfulness.
